catalog.name: LINE Stickers for Codex
catalog.description: An unofficial local LINE sticker picker for the Codex desktop composer, with pack search, favorites and enlarged previews.
catalog.zh: 在 Codex 桌面版輸入區選用本機 LINE 貼圖，提供貼圖包搜尋、最愛與放大預覽。
catalog.limits: Requires a prepared local runtime. The repository does not include Codex, sticker artwork or a ready-to-run app; compatibility depends on the desktop version.

catalog.name: TrayHelper
catalog.description: Keep supported Windows apps running when their last window closes. Restore individual windows from the tray or use a shortcut to bring them back.
catalog.zh: 把支援的 Windows 應用程式收到系統匣，提供視窗還原、快捷鍵與設定介面。
catalog.limits: Windows 10/11. Setup and standalone executables are available; per-app behavior and elevated windows have documented limits.

catalog.name: Stan Mic Bridge
catalog.description: Use a Mac microphone as a Windows virtual microphone over a private Tailscale connection. A native macOS menu bar sender keeps streaming while the browser is closed.
catalog.zh: 透過私人 Tailscale 連線，把 Mac 麥克風傳到 Windows 虛擬麥克風，方便遠端桌面與語音輸入。
catalog.limits: Requires macOS 12+, a configured Windows receiver, VB-CABLE and Tailscale. The Mac download is ad-hoc signed; receiver setup is separate.

catalog.name: HomeQuiet · 在家安靜
catalog.description: Clear notifications from selected apps while at a configured quiet location, using geofencing, location updates and an optional home Wi-Fi signal.
catalog.zh: 在設定的安靜地點自動清除指定 App 通知，使用地理圍欄、定位與可選的住家 Wi-Fi 判定。
catalog.limits: Distributed as an APK on GitHub. Location and notification access are needed for the documented workflow.

catalog.name: Instabox Windows fixes
catalog.description: Reproductions and patches for Windows URL quoting and SSH configuration paths containing spaces in instabox 0.5.2.
catalog.zh: 針對 instabox 0.5.2 的 Windows 網址引號與含空白 SSH 設定路徑問題，提供重現方法與修補檔。
catalog.limits: A separate patch and write-up. Publication here does not imply that the upstream project has merged or released the fixes.

catalog.name: Grok Bot Background Helper
catalog.description: An external tray helper for keeping Grok Bot in the background and restoring its window, without modifying the app files.
catalog.zh: 外部 Windows 系統匣工具，協助 Grok Bot 保持背景執行並還原視窗，不修改 App 檔案。
catalog.limits: An independent helper with application-specific setup. See TrayHelper for a broader close-to-tray tool.

catalog.name: Colonist.io Stats Tracker
catalog.description: A Chrome extension that tracks live dice rolls and resource counts in Colonist.io.
catalog.limits: Tracks a running Colonist.io game. Read the repository for supported game behavior and installation; it is not an official Colonist product.
catalog.zh: 在 Colonist.io 遊戲中追蹤骰點與資源數量的 Chrome 擴充功能。

catalog.name: Notify+
catalog.description: An Android app that organizes LINE notifications by conversation, with grouping and quick replies.
catalog.zh: 整理 LINE 對話通知的 Android 應用，提供分組與快速回覆。

catalog.name: Claude Status Monitor
catalog.description: Real-time Claude service status widget on claude.ai — uptime charts, live incidents, and alerts at a glance
catalog.limits: Shows public Claude service health. It does not monitor the progress of your local Claude Code sessions; use ClaudePulse for that separate task.
catalog.zh: 在 Claude 網頁上查看公開服務狀態、歷史 uptime 與事件公告。

catalog.name: Paper Stan and this portfolio
catalog.description: The full version of this site, with a resident paper-doll guide, an exploration quest, and MY PICTURE that runs away from your cursor
catalog.limits: The interactive edition and lightweight homepage are two interfaces to this portfolio, not separate commercial products.
catalog.zh: 這個個人網站的互動角色與輕量版本，提供作品導覽與公開來源。

catalog.name: Antnest Chatbot
catalog.description: An AI customer-service system for a dessert shop, combining LINE and web chat with reservations and an admin dashboard.
catalog.zh: 整合 LINE、網頁聊天、預約與後台的甜點店 AI 客服系統。

catalog.name: ETF Tracker
catalog.description: A personal dashboard that tracks Taiwan ETFs, US stocks, and BTC in one place - basically to keep track of my personal ETF
catalog.limits: A personal portfolio tracking application. This page describes software features, not investment recommendations or verified investment performance.
catalog.zh: 把台灣 ETF、美股與比特幣放在同一個畫面的個人追蹤工具。

catalog.name: ClaudePulse
catalog.description: A Windows monitor for multiple Claude Code sessions. Shows a notification when a session is finished or needs further handling
catalog.limits: Windows implementation inspired by tzangms/claudepulse for macOS. Session status and notifications are distinct from service uptime and account usage limits.
catalog.zh: Windows 上的 Claude Code 多工作階段狀態與完成通知工具。

catalog.name: YouTube Precise Time
catalog.description: Shows precise YouTube upload time, down to the second, on videos and Shorts. You no longer need to wonder when "two weeks ago " was
catalog.limits: Displays upload timestamps exposed by YouTube. It is not a tool for determining when a video was originally filmed.
catalog.zh: 查看 YouTube 影片與 Shorts 的精確上傳日期和時間。

catalog.name: Course Checker
catalog.description: A web app that checks how many more credits I need to graduate
catalog.limits: A personal credit-planning tool. Graduation eligibility still depends on the official requirements for the relevant department and enrollment year.
catalog.zh: 檢查畢業所需學分的個人網頁工具，正式資格以學校規定為準。

catalog.name: Status Monitor for ChatGPT
catalog.description: Displays public OpenAI service incidents and uptime in a widget on chatgpt.com. Includes English and Traditional Chinese interface options.
catalog.limits: Independent extension; not affiliated with OpenAI. Public service health is not your account quota or local session status.
catalog.zh: 在 ChatGPT 網頁查看 OpenAI 公開服務狀態的非官方擴充功能。

catalog.name: Dcard Article Formatter
catalog.description: Adds an on-page toggle for paragraph spacing, punctuation and Chinese–Latin text spacing in Dcard articles.
catalog.limits: Formatting changes affect the local reading view, not the original published article.
catalog.zh: 改善 Dcard 文章閱讀排版的擴充功能，不會修改原作者的文章。

catalog.name: Remove Glasp Remnants
catalog.description: Removes leftover Glasp interface elements from web pages and watches for newly inserted remnants.
catalog.limits: A focused browser cleanup utility. Read its requested site permissions before installing.
catalog.zh: 清理頁面上 Glasp 殘留介面元素的瀏覽器小工具。

catalog.name: Resource Sentinel
catalog.description: An earlier local coding-agent workload coordinator using resource snapshots, a shared SQLite reservation ledger and command admission wrappers.
catalog.limits: Admission depends on current measurements and configured headroom. It is not a hard operating-system memory cap; remote workers require their own measurements.
catalog.zh: 較早期的本機 coding agent 工作協調器，使用資源量測與共用預約帳本安排工作。

catalog.name: claude-mem-sync
catalog.description: Synchronizes a claude-mem database between devices through Supabase Storage and Claude Code session hooks.
catalog.limits: Requires your own configuration and Supabase project. Memory data leaves the device; review access controls and the source before enabling synchronization.
catalog.zh: 透過 Supabase Storage 同步 claude-mem 記憶資料庫的公開工具。

catalog.name: Stan Claude Harness
catalog.description: A collection of Claude Code configuration, custom agents, guard hooks and workflow notes for a personal coding environment.
catalog.limits: Personal settings are examples to inspect and adapt, not a universal security policy or a one-click safe configuration.
catalog.zh: 公開分享個人 Claude Code 配置、代理人、guard hooks 與工作流程。

catalog.name: OSS Contrib Starter
catalog.description: A Traditional Chinese introduction to reproducing issues, choosing contribution tasks, writing pull requests and keeping a contribution ledger.
catalog.limits: The introductory environment is macOS. Project-specific contribution rules take precedence; the guide does not guarantee program acceptance.
catalog.zh: 繁體中文的開源貢獻入門指南，包含問題重現、選題、PR 與紀錄範本。

catalog.name: Bedtime Hibernate
catalog.description: A Windows tray utility that can hibernate the computer after tracked Claude Code, Codex and Cursor activity becomes idle.
catalog.limits: Requires Windows hibernation support. Agent activity is inferred from transcript activity and process counters; that is not proof that every task has finished. Installation and runtime behavior were not retested for this directory.
catalog.zh: 觀察 Claude Code、Codex 與 Cursor 活動，在符合閒置條件後讓 Windows 休眠的系統匣工具。

catalog.name: AI Knowledge Tree
catalog.description: A pipeline that fetches AI news from RSS feeds, extracts structured events with an LLM, removes duplicates and writes Markdown for an Obsidian vault.
catalog.limits: Requires provider configuration and an API key. Model availability and generated summaries need review; the public code is not a hosted news service.
catalog.zh: 把 AI 新聞 RSS 整理成結構化事件、去重，並寫入 Obsidian Markdown 的公開管線。

catalog.name: Sealevel Sentinel
catalog.description: A command-line tool that applies static-analysis rules to Solana Anchor and Rust programs, with an optional language-model reasoning layer.
catalog.limits: The README documents limits of the rule layer and states that the optional paid API path had not been exercised. A clean result is not a security guarantee; benchmark claims were not rerun for this directory.
catalog.zh: 針對 Solana Anchor 與 Rust 程式進行規則式靜態檢查，並提供選用模型分析層的命令列工具。

catalog.name: DD Q-list Engine
catalog.description: A local due-diligence workbench that organizes source documents, drafts question lists through multiple perspectives and supports human review and follow-up rounds.
catalog.limits: The public repository supplies a synthetic demonstration rather than real client data. Some bundled analyses and reviewer outputs are hand-written examples; live operation requires provider configuration and human review.
catalog.zh: 整理文件、以多個視角產生盡職調查問題清單，並支援人工審閱與多輪追問的本機工作台。

catalog.name: DCA Backtest
catalog.description: A minimal Streamlit application for exploring dollar-cost averaging backtests.
catalog.limits: Runs from source with local Python dependencies. Historical simulations are not investment recommendations or evidence of future returns; the calculations were not independently validated for this directory.
catalog.zh: 以 Streamlit 製作的定期定額回測工具，公開原始碼與本機執行方式。

catalog.name: Anote — PDF Reader
catalog.description: A browser PDF reader with page navigation, zoom controls and notes placed beside selected text.
catalog.zh: 提供分頁、縮放與文字旁註的瀏覽器 PDF 閱讀器。

selectedContributions.en: Kept the classic consumer polling during an authentication test so the group handshake could finish under load.
selectedContributions.zh: 修正驗證測試中 classic consumer 未持續 poll 的情況，讓群組握手能在負載下完成。
selectedContributions.lesson: A test that observes a state may also need to keep the protocol making progress. Separate a timing failure from an authentication failure.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR records local reproduction of the earlier failure and 300 repetitions by an upstream reviewer after the final refactor. These are historical PR reports, not tests rerun for this website.

selectedContributions.en: Removed Windows-reserved characters from Ray Tune trial directory names and added regression coverage.
selectedContributions.zh: 處理 Ray Tune 試驗目錄名稱中的 Windows 保留字元，並加入回歸測試。
selectedContributions.lesson: Cross-platform outputs need portable filenames even when they are initially created on another operating system.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR describes a Windows 11 reproduction and regression tests that fail before the change and pass afterward.

selectedContributions.en: Unified Unix-socket URL generation and parsing for Windows drive paths and POSIX paths.
selectedContributions.zh: 統一 ToolHive 的 Unix socket URL 產生與解析，處理 Windows 磁碟路徑與 POSIX 路徑。
selectedContributions.lesson: Test serialization and parsing together. A path that looks absolute on one platform may not be recognized as absolute on another.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR records focused Go discovery and API tests on Windows; it explicitly does not claim a full repository test run.

selectedContributions.en: Normalized OpenRouter conversation history to avoid sending an empty messages array and losing observations.
selectedContributions.zh: 正規化 OpenRouter 對話歷史，避免送出空的 messages 陣列而失去觀測紀錄。
selectedContributions.lesson: Provider-specific adapters need equivalent validation when a shared normalization step changes.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR records four focused message-normalization tests and discloses AI-assisted implementation.

selectedContributions.en: Fixed PowerShell archive extraction when a Windows user path contains an apostrophe.
selectedContributions.zh: 修正 Windows 使用者路徑包含單引號時，PowerShell 解壓縮備援流程失敗的問題。
selectedContributions.lesson: Use literal-path semantics and correct quoting for the target shell. Test a real path containing the character that broke the command.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR records a real Windows extraction with the primary tar path forced to fail, plus quoting tests; it also documents a remaining Linux-specific test limitation on Windows.

selectedContributions.en: Restored Windows helper downloads when the matching GitHub release tag had moved beyond the first page of releases.
selectedContributions.zh: 修正 Windows 輔助程式的 GitHub release 標籤移到第二頁後，下載流程找不到檔案的問題。
selectedContributions.lesson: A fresh Windows build could finish with a warning but omit the executable needed for Hold / Push-to-Talk: the prefix lookup read only the first 50 releases. The fix follows the next-page link, with a limit of 20 pages of 100 releases, while preserving exact-tag lookup. This handles older helper releases without pinning every downloader to a single tag.
selectedContributions.validation: The original PR reports a live Windows 11 lookup returning the missing tag and ZIP asset. Follow-up maintainer commits replaced the initial four-test helper with three tests using mocked HTTPS responses, added a missing-binary packaging check, and adjusted CI compilation. Those follow-up changes are credited to the maintainers. The upstream tests and packaged application were not rerun for this page.

selectedContributions.en: Prevented slide copies from creating directory names that differ only by letter case and collide on case-insensitive filesystems.
selectedContributions.zh: 避免複製投影片時產生僅有大小寫不同的目錄名稱，導致移至不區分大小寫的檔案系統時發生衝突。
selectedContributions.lesson: On ext4, Cover and cover can coexist, so an existence check alone allowed a slide ID that would collide on a case-insensitive filesystem. The fix compares the directory names without regard to case: an explicitly requested conflicting ID is rejected, and an automatically generated copy name advances to the next suffix.
selectedContributions.validation: The PR reports a focused Node filesystem check on macOS for requested IDs and generated copy names. It explicitly leaves the pnpm test suite, format check and lint unchecked because the author lacked the local pnpm installation. Regression tests were added to slide-ops.test.ts, but neither those suites nor cross-platform runtime behavior were rerun for this page.

research.name: Math Notebook
research.description: AI-assisted computational mathematics with interactive explainers, sequence computations and Lean formal checks.
research.limits: The repository distinguishes small new computations, confirmations of earlier results and unfinished questions. Finite searches do not prove an open conjecture.

research.name: AIMO R01A negative study
research.description: A reproducible retrospective study of whether fixed text-structure features improve a matched-family mathematics benchmark.
research.limits: The prespecified improvement was not observed. This is a negative result with replay artifacts, not a hidden-test score or a competition award.

research.name: Vesuvius HF65 alignment
research.description: Coordinate mapping and resampling tools for comparing HF65 image canvases with tifxyz surfaces, with held-out-region checks.
research.limits: Reported alignment results apply to the segments and regions evaluated in the repository; they are not a guarantee for every scan.

research.name: Vesuvius layout constraints
research.description: An experiment translating two-dimensional ink layout into constraints for three-dimensional spiral fitting, with documented A/B tests and follow-up runs.
research.limits: The reported GPU follow-up did not separate a small decline from seed variation. An improvement in reconstruction quality has not been established.

research.name: PHerc0139 gap investigation
research.description: A CT-based investigation of material layers and mesh geometry around a gap, with cross-sections, measurements and reproduction code.
research.limits: The study covers part of the gap and leaves compressed layers unresolved. It does not claim to recover the missing winding.

research.name: Typeless Lab
research.description: A public experiment comparing speech recognition and language-model correction for Traditional Chinese dictation.
research.limits: The README identifies synthetic TTS speech, a small corpus and hardware-specific timing. Reported benchmark results should not be generalized to ordinary live speech.

research.name: Vesuvius ink-depth validation
research.description: A public preregistered study of Vesuvius 3D ink labels against an independent scan.
research.limits: A validation study, not a claim of a solved historical-text or mathematics problem.

research.name: Autoresearch — Index Strategies
research.description: A public experiment in hypothesis-driven automated research, with strategy evaluation, experiment records and a separate historical validation step.
research.limits: The README describes a limited historical training and validation period and lists broader market-regime testing as unfinished. This directory does not independently validate its financial results or present them as investment advice.

research.name: Financial commentary factor research
research.description: A public research roadmap studying whether Chinese-language financial commentary adds predictive information beyond existing price-and-volume factors.
research.limits: The June 2026 roadmap explicitly marks the core incremental-information test against Alpha101 as unfinished. Existing proof-of-concept results do not establish independent predictive value or verified investment performance.
